title: Thousand-Window Sovereign
text: Thousand-Window Sovereign opens a court of reflected possibilities and attacks from every choice the operative refused. On loss, suffer 2 Wounds.
flavor: Only one figure is real, and it is not interested in proving which.

defeatReward.text: Thousand-Window Sovereign is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
